name: Blockstrike
description: Fast low-poly arena FPS: Quake-style movement (air strafing, bunny hops, slide-hops), three weapons and a 4-minute free-for-all against bots.

store.tagline: Fast low-poly arena FPS with Quake-style movement and bots or friends.
store.description:
Blockstrike is a fast, low-poly arena shooter in the spirit of blocky browser FPS games. Quake-style movement rewards skill: air strafing, speed-preserving bunny hops and slide-hops. Pick from three weapons — assault rifle, one-shot-headshot sniper, and shotgun — and fight a 4-minute free-for-all against 5 bots (Easy/Normal/Hard), or start an online room for 2-4 players: share the code or invite link and friends join from their own Möbius or any browser.

Everything is original and procedural: all geometry is generated code, all sound is synthesized with WebAudio, and there are no downloaded models, textures or audio files. Three.js is the only runtime dependency.
